CommunityApplications.Profile:
Podium is a thin, self-updating static-site runner in a single container: point it at one or more GitHub repos and it clones, builds, and serves each on its own port, then polls every branch and redeploys whenever you push — no image rebuilds or manual deploys. Tracks upstream closely; it's just nginx + node + git + a watch script.
This repository maintains a single container: podium. For help, bug reports, or feature requests, open an issue at https://github.com/ggardenhire/podium/issues.
